questions.question: How satisfied were you with the academic programme at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Were you a BA or MA student at UCPH when you were on exchange? *
questions.answer: MA

questions.question: Did you take BA or MA courses at your host university? *
questions.answer: Both

questions.answer: my 4 subjects were very different and had different levels. Some of the subjects were very new to me and might be the reason for the high level, besides that I did not find it totally impossible to follow.

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: Again very different compared to how big the class was in each subject.

questions.answer: 1 semester

1. From lab to life
2. Microscopy for biological sciences
3. Epidemiology 1 
4. Gender and health
